modelSettings: tool-managed defaults; no explicit seed or model parameters exposed
usageBoundary: Primary concept reference for analysis, annotation, comparison, and human review only. Never use its pixels as production component geometry, masks, materials, or final assets.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: V3 portrait-mobile game UI concept reference

Primary request:
Create one polished 9:16 portrait mobile-game screen concept titled exactly ‘FROSTBOUND REWARD’. The screen establishes a coherent icy-fantasy direction and a bounded reconstruction target consisting of a Panel, Button family, and Progress component. It is a visual reference only, not a cut-apart asset sheet or final component source.

Scene and backdrop:
A restrained dark arctic-blue game backdrop with subtle cold mist and faint snow motes. No characters, scenery narrative, products, logos, device frame, or background clutter.

Subject and layout:
Center a large frosted-crystal reward popup with generous safe margins. Use a carved silver-blue frame, translucent icy inset surfaces, clean editable content slots, and a clear top-to-bottom hierarchy:
1. Header labeled exactly ‘FROSTBOUND REWARD’.
2. A prominent reward-content area with a simple abstract crystal reward emblem and open space around it.
3. A horizontal progress component labeled exactly ‘75%’, with unmistakable filled versus unfilled states.
4. A large dominant primary action button labeled exactly ‘CLAIM’.
5. A smaller, quieter secondary action button labeled exactly ‘LATER’.
Include one clearly selected/active state within the popup using shape, luminous border, and value contrast—not text alone.

Style:
High-quality stylized fantasy mobile-game UI concept; crystalline ice, frosted glass, carved metal, restrained snow grain, and subtle rune geometry. Practical, readable, and shippable-looking rather than painterly. Unified component family with reusable material language and bounded ornament. Avoid neon-market styling, sci-fi circuitry, photorealism, overly ornate filigree, and generic web-dashboard aesthetics.

Composition and hierarchy:
Exact portrait 9:16 composition, conceptually suitable for 540×960 logical pixels / 1080×1920 presentation. Target-phone readability. The primary CLAIM button must be unmistakably more important than LATER through scale, placement, fill, glow, and contrast. Component silhouettes must remain clearly separable while belonging to the same family.

Lighting and palette:
Cool overhead lighting, cyan-white crystalline edge glints, deep navy shadows, ice blue and white surfaces, with at most a tiny restrained violet accent. Strong legibility and accessible contrast.

Materials:
Frost/crystal surface language should suggest reusable normalized material inputs: subtle tileable-looking frost grain, consistent bevels, repeatable highlights, and independent glow/shadow effects. Do not imply unique baked full-component textures.

Text constraints:
Render only these exact text strings and no others:
‘FROSTBOUND REWARD’
‘75%’
‘CLAIM’
‘LATER’
Keep all text crisp, correctly spelled, horizontal, and readable.

Hard constraints:
Single screen only. No watermark, signature, brand mark, trademark, character, device mockup, Unity editor chrome, cut lines, exploded parts, multiple variants, asset-sheet layout, or explanatory annotations. Preserve editable-looking geometry and empty content space.
